page_title: BHA 3-2 LIV | Brighton v Liverpool 19/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Andy Madley is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
90+3' Harry Howell (Brighton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
85' Referee Andy Madley points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) goes wild in celebration.
85' Wait! Referee Andy Madley immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
85' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
84' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Harry Howell (Brighton) replaces Danny Welbeck.
84' Yankuba Minteh goes off the pitch and Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) comes on.
82' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
81' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
80' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
79' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
77' Substitution. Conor Bradley did his best and is replaced by Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
77' Adam Webster (Brighton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andy Madley had an easy-decision to make.
77' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
76' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
74' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Yasin Ayari will be replaced by Diego Gomez (Brighton).
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Matt O'Riley (Brighton) is replacing Brajan Gruda.
73' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
69' 2 - 2 Goal! Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
69' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Alisson makes a great save.
68' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) sends it out of play.
68' Bart Verbruggen pulls off a great save to deny Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
65' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Simon Adingra is replaced by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton).

64' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
63' It is time for a substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is on for Dominik Szoboszlai.
63' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Cody Gakpo and he is replaced by Luis Diaz (Liverpool).
63' A substitution has been made. Federico Chiesa goes off and Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) comes on.
63' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar.
62' Simon Adingra (Brighton) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.

61' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
60' A corner kick by Brighton is thwarted by the well prepared Alisson (Liverpool).
60' What a sweet touch by Danny Welbeck (Brighton) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Alisson to hold.
58' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
57' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
56' Adam Webster (Brighton) attempts to find Yankuba Minteh, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
54' Good chance! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!

54' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
54' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
52' Dangerous play by Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool). Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brighton.
51' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.

51' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the right side of the goal, but Alisson denies him with a great save.
49' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
49' The game is interrupted now, Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' Referee Andy Madley blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' 1 - 2 Brilliant finish! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Harvey Elliott, then produced a nice strike into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:2.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A pass into the box finds Brajan Gruda (Brighton) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the roof of the net, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alisson denies him.
43' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Bart Verbruggen has no trouble gathering it.

43' A pass lands at the feet of Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) picks up a long through ball, but Bart Verbruggen deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
39' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.

38' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Liverpool are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
35' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Alisson makes a save.
35' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
34' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.

32' 1 - 1 Brajan Gruda sends a lovely ball into Yasin Ayari (Brighton). He latches on to it and shoots into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:1.
31' The shot by Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Alisson.
29' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Danny Welbeck (Brighton), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post.
28' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
28' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
26' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
25' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) on the edge of the box.

25' It looks like Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) saw red with that tackle. Andy Madley won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Liverpool.
22' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
21' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
18' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
16' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Yasin Ayari, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
14' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
13' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
12' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
12' Simon Adingra (Brighton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Brighton force a corner. They send men into the box.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Conor Bradley rounded the goalkeeper and sent a sweet pass to Harvey Elliott (Liverpool), who had an easy finish to put it into an empty net. 0:1.
9' PENALTY APPEAL after Brajan Gruda (Brighton) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
7' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
5' Adam Webster (Brighton) brings his opponent down. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Liverpool in a dangerous position.
5' A cross into the box from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared.
3' Liverpool are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
2' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Andy Madley is introduced as the referee for today's match.
